name: diagram-tools
description: Validated Archify maps with opt-in Cloudflare Pages sharing, plus Mermaid rendering with editable source.

interface.shortDescription: Create diagrams and share accepted Archify maps.
interface.longDescription: Diagram Tools makes Archify the graphical default for validated interactive architecture and workflow maps while preserving Pretty Mermaid for explicit Mermaid, compact static diagrams, and terminal ASCII. Both lanes retain editable source and use guarded local runtimes. Installation-specific opt-in enables automatic Cloudflare Pages sharing after Archify visual review, with local previews retained.
defaultPrompt: Use $archify to create a validated interactive architecture or workflow map with retained typed JSON source.
Use $pretty-mermaid for explicit Mermaid, compact static diagrams, or terminal ASCII.
Render these Mermaid sources as terminal-friendly ASCII.
